info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Healthcare Appointments Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Status API provides access to the current status of healthcare appointments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of appointments along with their respective statuses, enabling effective management and oversight of patient scheduling. Healthcare providers, office managers, and patient care coordinators are typical consumers of this API, using it to facilitate appointment tracking and improve patient engagement. By integrating this API, organizations can optimize their operational workflows and enhance communication with patients regarding their scheduled appointments.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of appointments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the current status of all appointments, providing important information on their progress and any changes that may have occurred.
